verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the official GitHub README, which states that Solo 2 "also speaks ... PIV" alongside FIDO2, OATH and OpenPGP. That establishes PIV smart-card support exists but says nothing about how well it serves the admin's certificate-login scenarios. Missing for 10: documentation of PIV slots and certificate provisioning, evidence of Windows/macOS/Linux workstation smart-card logon, VPN client-certificate use, code-signing workflows, on-device key generation or non-exportability guarantees, admin tooling for PIV management, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
